label_note: PROCEDURAL_GENERATED (not AI_GENERATED): this iteration uses a local deterministic procedural generator, not an external AI model.
source_method: local procedural Skin-modifier human -> single watertight manifold surface
topology_method: Blender Skin modifier on a connected branching skeleton welds arms+legs into the torso as one manifold shell (0 boundary edges, 0 non-manifold edges, 1 connected component). Replaces the earlier tube prototype which had 80 boundary edges and 5 disconnected shells.
why_local: No external AI mesh service reachable (Tripo/Meshy HTTP 000, no API keys) and no MPFB/MB-Lab addon installed in this environment; pipeline rule 4 fallback. See docs/PLUGIN_STATUS.md.

generator.name: tools/blender/ai_character_pipeline.py
generator.license: own script (no third-party asset); Blender is GPL

rigging.rigify_reason: Rigify bone naming does not match the required spec convention; see docs/PLUGIN_STATUS.md

topology.uv_method: Blender Smart UV Project (auto-unwrap; unblocks tint/texture workflow, not a hand-laid production UV)
topology.note: one frozen Skin-modifier base M; average = M, lean/fat = M + a thin/fat displacement baked into the basis; every shape key is an analytic displacement of the same frozen vertex list, so topology is identical everywhere

morph_effectiveness.measured_by: render_character_qa.py local shoulder-width (z~1.44) and torso-only waist-width (z~1.17) metrics
morph_effectiveness.note: region-aware deltoid/pectoral/biceps/thigh/calf bumps for muscle; front-heavy belly + glute for fat; all smooth (no spikes), topology preserved

deformation_qa.test: body_muscle=1.0 + waist_narrow=0.8, shoulders and hips rotated, then check exploded/collapsed/non-manifold
deformation_qa.result: PASS on all variants (vertex reach ~1.75m, posed height ~1.70m, 0 non-manifold edges)

variant_fields.lean: thin displacement field baked into basis
variant_fields.fat: fat displacement field baked into basis (belly/waist/hips/chest/face fullness)

input_parameters.note: lean/fat are comparison outputs derived from the same frozen average base, NOT separate progression bases

morphs.face_morphs: OUT OF SCOPE for v2 (no facial identity work); a later V3 face adapter would add them

outputs.qa: assets/characters/ai_prototype/qa/ (per-variant validation.json, qa_report.json, contact_sheet.png, morph sweeps, combos)

validator_result.average: PASS (0 required failures; UV absent = WARN)
validator_result.lean: PASS (0 required failures; UV absent = WARN)
validator_result.fat: PASS (0 required failures; UV absent = WARN)

qa_result.hard_gates: boundary edge, non-manifold edge, feet-off-ground, or vertex-count change at any morph state; inward-normal fraction is informational only and never gates (review item 8)

known_limitations: Procedural Skin-modifier surface, watertight and manifold, but NOT a sculpted production base mesh: no deliberate facial edge flow, minimal hands/feet detail, generic quad-ish flow from the Skin modifier.
UV is an auto Smart-UV-Project set (TEXCOORD_0 present, tint/texture workflow unblocked), NOT a hand-laid production UV with reviewed padding/islands.
No texture maps yet (neutral material color only).

FACE IS OUT OF SCOPE: the 8 facial morphs (face_wide/narrow, jaw, eyes, nose) are NOT present on the procedural body and are NOT faked on a smooth head. The full 18-morph profile therefore fails by design; the body profile is the target for this iteration. Facial topology + morphs require a real production base mesh (a V3 face experiment behind a separate adapter). Eye-marker proxies in the stylization prototype are NOT facial validation.
Auto (envelope) skin weights, not hand-painted; deformation QA confirms they hold under posing+morphs, but they are not production-tuned.
NOT PRODUCTION APPROVED. Suitable for pipeline validation and body-proportion prototyping only.
